only_allowed_changes.before: Remove the oil-filter cover, filter and O-rings. Remove radiator pipe 2 from the right-cover interface and discard its O-ring. Remove the right-cover bolts and lift the cover without forcing the water-pump shaft drive. Keep the pump assembled to the cover. Recover the dowels and collar; discard the cover gasket and collar O-ring. Index the cover fasteners using the exploded view.
only_allowed_changes.after: Remove the oil-filter cover, filter and O-ring. Remove radiator pipe 2 from the right-cover interface and discard its O-ring. Remove the right-cover bolts and lift the cover without forcing the water-pump shaft drive. Keep the pump assembled to the cover. Recover the dowels and collar; discard the cover gasket and collar O-ring. Index the cover fasteners using the exploded view.

only_allowed_changes.before: Fit radiator pipe 2 with a new O-ring lubricated with LS grease, following the illustrated joint orientation; tighten the joint bolt to 10 Nm. Install a new oil filter and new LS-greased cover O-rings, then the filter cover at 10 Nm. Keep oil and coolant unfilled at this bench stage.
only_allowed_changes.after: Fit radiator pipe 2 with a new O-ring lubricated with LS grease, following the illustrated joint orientation; tighten the joint bolt to 10 Nm.
